title: Independence Day script came from the CIA

tellings.quote: that whole script was like out of CIA central scripting casting.

plain: The script of Independence Day, the 1996 alien-invasion film starring Will Smith, came straight out of the CIA, according to the UFO activist Steven Greer. He tells Michels the whole script was "like out of CIA central scripting casting", without naming a source. If true, it would mean the CIA shapes how the public imagines aliens through Hollywood.
